Updates the picked repeaters over LoRa one after another, to the same release.

Updates the picked repeaters over LoRa one after another, to the same release: each gets the file for its board. It logs in with the kept password, makes a backup, then updates. Only those with no hop can be updated; the nearest go first. It keeps to the airtime limit (10% an hour), so it can take hours. If it stops (Stop, the app closed, the companion gone), it goes on from there. A repeater whose new file must be copied over the old one is skipped: update that one by hand.
